# IBP — Infrastructure Builders' Programme

> Free, public RPC endpoints for the Polkadot ecosystem. Member-owned bare-metal hardware, GeoDNS-routed, no API keys, no rate limits.

The IBP is a federation of seven independent operators running RPC, bootnodes, archive nodes, and validators across four continents (Europe, Africa, Asia, the Americas). Treasury-funded since 2022 (Kusama Ref 35), and from 2024 also by Polkadot. Asset Hub Polkadot is the consumer chain; relay-chain endpoints are for validators and parachain collators. The canonical, always-current operator list lives at https://github.com/ibp-network/config.

Primary endpoint: `wss://asset-hub-polkadot.dotters.network`

## Build (developer docs)

- [Quickstart](https://ibp.network/build/start/quickstart): a typed Polkadot client in five minutes via PAPI.
- [Pick a library](https://ibp.network/build/start/pick-a-library): PAPI vs reactive-dot vs Dedot vs subxt vs viem vs ethers.
- [PAPI](https://ibp.network/build/connect/papi): the default TypeScript path.
- [reactive-dot](https://ibp.network/build/connect/reactive-dot): React hooks over PAPI.
- [Dedot](https://ibp.network/build/connect/dedot): Polkadot.js-shaped API with type-safe extrinsics.
- [subxt](https://ibp.network/build/connect/subxt): the Rust path.
- [Asset Hub overview](https://ibp.network/build/asset-hub/overview): why it's the chain, what lives on it, common queries.
- [Smoldot light client](https://ibp.network/build/light-client/smoldot): trustless in-browser, no hosted RPC dependency.
- [EVM on Asset Hub](https://ibp.network/build/evm/overview): viem / ethers, chain ID `420420417` for Paseo EVM.
- [Wallet connection](https://ibp.network/build/recipes/wallet-connect): Talisman, SubWallet, Nova, Polkadot.js extension.
- [Explorers](https://ibp.network/build/recipes/explorers): one-click links into dev.papi.how and polkadot.js.org/apps.
- [LLMs and AI agents](https://ibp.network/build/recipes/llm-and-agents): MCP server patterns, prompt scaffolding.
- [Runtime view functions](https://ibp.network/build/recipes/view-functions): `api.view.X.Y(...)` for read-only pallet queries.

## Endpoints

- [All endpoints](https://ibp.network/endpoints): copyable WSS / HTTPS URLs per chain, bootnode multiaddrs for trustless sync. Asset Hub first; relay chains are split into a "validator / collator endpoints" sub-section.
- Machine-readable manifest (JSON, chain → wss URL per pool): <https://ibp.network/endpoints.json>
- Two redundant GeoDNS pools: `dotters.network` and `ibp.network`.
- Primary connectable endpoint: `wss://asset-hub-polkadot.dotters.network` — free, no API key, no rate limits.

## Members

- [Members](https://ibp.network/members): the seven operators (Amforc, Dwellir, Gatotech, RadiumBlock, Rotko Networks, Stake Plus, Turboflakes), region codes, 2D / 3D service map, per-operator request volume.
